docs.purpose: Where a new user creates an account with an email and password, confirming the password twice. Because email confirmation is switched on, after submitting they see a 'check your email' state with a button to send the link again if it never arrives. A phone sign-up path with a texted code and a recovery-email step exists in the code but is currently hidden.
docs.data_story: This surface reaches **no API contract at all** — every value it shows is local, passed in as a prop, or read from the device. It holds no client-side store, so there is no local copy of server state to keep in sync.
docs.under_126: **LEAVE ALONE — deliberately out of scope.** This screen talks to the Supabase Auth SDK, not to our contracts, so a descriptor would be describing someone else's protocol. Spec 126's Operating Boundaries fence it explicitly.

contracts: mobile/app/(auth)/sign-up.tsx:185-189 — all Supabase Auth SDK; the screen reaches no /api/ route
tables: mobile/app/(auth)/sign-up.tsx — GoTrue writes auth.users; user_profiles is created later by the profile route's self-provision INSERT

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-15)

versioning.why: It produces a Supabase user, not a payload; nothing in the repo consumes a shape from this screen.

inputs.why: Typed email/password/OTP/backup-email only; the screen calls no application contract and reads no server projection.

outputs.why: signUp() with confirmations ON returns session:null, so nothing is written anywhere the client can see until the emailed link is tapped; the phone branch creates the GoTrue user on verifyOtp.
outputs.rollback: none — a failed signUp leaves the form populated with an inline error; there is no partial server state to undo.

state.why: It owns no store: every value is component state, and the session (when one eventually arrives) is written by the root layout's auth listener.

session.why: The unauthenticated registration entry point; it projects no server-sourced field.

disclosure.why: Anonymous, but every rendered string is compiled-in copy; the only user-visible value is the email the user typed.

guards.flag: PHONE_AUTH_ENABLED (mobile/src/lib/featureFlags.ts:24 — gates both the in-page toggle and the ?method=phone deep link)
guards.rate_bucket: none — GoTrue owns the signup and resend throttles; resendSignupConfirmation surfaces their message verbatim

checks.why: phoneGate.coverage.test.ts locks entry points (b) and (c): the in-page toggle render AND the resolveSignUpMethod computation, so a stale ?method=phone deep link cannot enter a gated flow.

With confirmations ON, signUp resolves with session:null; the testID-tagged signup-check-email block plus the resend affordance is what stops the user being stranded on a dead form (sign-up.tsx:234-271).
mobile/__tests__/confirmEmail.test.ts pins resendSignupConfirmation, which exists because mail-provider security scanners can consume the one-time PKCE code before the real tap.
Declared and NOT satisfied: the recovery email collected in the phone branch is never written anywhere. See limitations.
Eight attributes cover the headers and the submit buttons; the three email/password TextInputs carry testIDs but no accessibilityLabel.

errors.why: One inline red line per form section, mapped from the Supabase error code, plus an error haptic; nothing navigates on failure.

classes.ui: mapSupabaseError copy inline (weak password, email in use, bad OTP); local validation messages use the same line.
GoTrue throttle copy; the resend affordance surfaces its own message string.

emits.why: Five events cover the screen view with its arrival method, both completion paths, and the phone attempt/failure/verify arc — codes only, never the credential.

offers.why: No sponsored placement is rendered: the only slot component in the Expo tree is SponsorSlot, and it returns null unless EXPO_PUBLIC_PARCEL_SPONSORS=1.

metering.why: Nothing here is counted: the Spec 126 §7 usage ledger table does not exist (grep for usage_events in the introspected drizzle schema returns 0 hits), and the only quota-shaped counter, user_profiles.lead_views_count, is incremented solely by POST /api/leads/view, which has no mobile caller.

config.why: The surface consumes no registered logic variable: the only server-side tunable in this path, user_profiles.radius_cap_km, is a per-user admin column, not a logic_variables row.

limitations.what: The phone branch's "Recovery email — in case you lose phone access" field is collected and then discarded: the submit handler fires an analytics event, closes the sheet, and writes the value nowhere.
limitations.measured: sign-up.tsx:208-224 — handleSubmitBackupEmail validates the address, calls track('signup_completed'), closes the sheet and returns; there is no PATCH, no store write and no route param carrying backupEmail. user_profiles.backup_email stays null.

limitations.what: signup_completed fires for the phone branch at the backup-email step even though the GoTrue user was created one step earlier, so the two branches mark completion at different moments.
limitations.measured: sign-up.tsx:112 fires it right after signUp for email; sign-up.tsx:221 fires it after the backup-email submit for phone.

notes: PhoneInputField and OtpInputField are rendered here and in sign-in, so neither surface owns them (R-13 totality gap). The whole phone branch is unreachable while PHONE_AUTH_ENABLED is false, which means the discarded-backup-email defect is currently latent rather than live.

programme.why: Authentication. It talks to the Supabase Auth SDK and gates entry to both products; no product owns it.
